caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a bearded man mounted on a classical pedestal base. The bust shows the head and upper torso of the individual, with detailed facial features including a long, wavy hairstyle, a mustache, and a pointed beard. He is dressed in period clothing, featuring a high, stiff ruffled collar and a buttoned garment. The bust is shaded in tones of sepia, giving a monochromatic brown appearance throughout both the figure and the pedestal. The background is a plain, light tan color, and there are no other objects or details included in the composition. The drawing focuses centrally on the bust, with all elements rendered in a consistent style and color palette.
title: Bust of Gov. John Winthrop
